issues.reviewReason: Root cause found: the Daily Volume TARGET is not derived from today's plan at all. The app shows weekly_volume_target_kg / 7, and that weekly figure is last week's ACTUAL logged volume x1.05 (from backend /activity/overview). So the denominator has no relation to today's 11 exercises / 29 planned sets, which is why 2 exercises nearly fill it. Recommended fix (full-stack): backend adds planned_volume_today_kg = sum over today's exercises of target_sets x reps x reference_weight (reference weight proxied from each exercise's last logged set, since the plan stores no target weight); FE reads that instead of weekly/7. This changes what 'daily volume target' means (a product decision) and needs a backend deploy, so flagging for your call. Can implement next tick on approval.
